rules: SET filters only set_option; INHERIT filters only inherit_option; MEMBER ignores both
Every reached current database owner has implicit pg_database_owner membership in all three traversals
Implicit membership is not an explicit row/admin_option grant
ADMIN examines explicit admin_option rows from MEMBER closure, preserving grantors/parallel rows
No arbitrary recursion cap; visited roles terminate finite cycles
scope: Boolean closure/ADMIN property on validated consumed graph operands. Not general can_set_role/has_privs wrappers, full scalar encoding/ACL validation, source exhaustiveness or canonical qualification.
